result.summary: A dark-themed desktop application window for 'ZephyrDesktop', an AI coding assistant. It has a top title bar, a left sidebar for tasks/chats, a central chat panel with an empty state and composer, and a right panel with tabs and a file list. The layout is composed of distinct panels separated by thin borders, with a floating rounded composer and rounded suggestion cards in the center.

regions.text: Top bar: back/forward arrows, sidebar toggle, ZephyrDesktop logo and title, File/View/Help menus, right-side icons (bell, sidebar, refresh, minimize, maximize, close)
Left sidebar: New task button, ZephyrDesktop section, Today section, New chat item highlighted
Center chat panel: New chat header, empty-state icon, heading 'Ask about this code.', helper text, three suggestion cards, composer input at bottom
Bottom composer: placeholder text, plus button, Zephyr model selector, mr-vip selector, send button
Bottom status row: Interactive, Work, Auto, 0 messages, 0%
Right panel: Changes and Files tabs, file tree, empty-state message 'Open a file from Files or Changes to see it here.'

semantics.scene: Desktop application UI, dark theme, AI coding assistant workspace
semantics.intent: Provide an interface for chatting with an AI agent about code, browsing files, and viewing changes

visual.style: Dark, minimal, flat-column application UI with rounded floating elements
notes: Three-column layout: narrow left sidebar, wide central chat panel, medium right files panel
Panels are divided by thin vertical borders rather than being separate floating cards
Left sidebar sits directly on window background
Composer is a large rounded rectangle with pill-shaped inner controls
Suggestion cards are rounded rectangles stacked vertically
Right panel tab strip has rounded active tab
Empty-state icon is a blue rounded square with a white lightning/arrow symbol

uncertainty: Small icons and model selector text may be partially ambiguous due to resolution
Exact pixel widths of columns are approximate
Some file tree icons are small and could be misidentified
